### Exact-head hosted verification complete

Reviewed head `362432da26525229a06c05dea0be1db59a358e59`, tree `1151529f41c0b0214f0a37b52cabc33d595a3e10`, actual base `c63cd44815ef84f498d1e2fbe46c354416b81cdc`; tested merge `f4a9a15ce19c1214d9c2e384a5641fec1f5035df` has those exact parents and tree.

[Run 40418139149](https://github.com/c933103/AN-Paint/actions/runs/40418139149) completed **all six jobs successfully on attempt 1**. Downloaded artifacts were independently digest-checked and revalidated against this source:
- Regression artifact `12697307810`: **1,399 JVM tests**, 151 XML suites, zero failures/errors/skips; 14 focused classes/82 exact methods including the repaired checkbox test; hosted Python **1,447 pass +2 skip**, lint **0**.
- Composed API35 artifact `12697898153`: **47 app +74 native cases**, exact case identities/source/APK/test-APK bytes; Core/Position/composition attempts **1/1/1** with independent selection from fresh GitHub job/artifact timestamps.
- APK/source `12696761365`: **1,385 packaged source files**, **1,659 compiled reviewed/preserved entries**, exact tree and APK signature.
- Exact-script `12696211274`: **13 probes** and expected negative verified.

Fresh ordinary/optimized local suites each passed **1,449** tests. Current-head Code receipt [6429573796](https://github.com/c933103/AN-Paint/pull/184#issuecomment-6429573796) and full machine summary are clean; the existing Security summary still identifies the old head and is not represented as current-head review.

The original run40413471740's JVM assertion and independent emulator-package installation failure remain failed historical evidence, not reclassified as passes. No release; merge readiness remains subject to the final live head/base/check lease.
